### Step 1 — Scene
A breakfast tray with a fried egg, toast, a small English-muffin cheese sandwich, a sweet muffin, and coffee with apparent milk.

### Step 2 — Vessels
- Main plate: approximately **23 cm** diameter; area = 3.14 × 11.5² ≈ **415 cm²**.
- Muffin side plate: approximately **19 cm** diameter; area ≈ **283 cm²**. This is part of the central meal.
- Coffee mug: approximately **8 cm** opening; surface area ≈ **50 cm²**.

### Steps 3–7 — Items, area, volume, weight, and energy
The sandwich is estimated as one combined item because its filling cannot be fully separated visually. Fried-egg energy includes cooking fat; no additional oil is counted.

| Toast slice | 26% of main plate | 108 × 1.6 ≈ 173 ml | 0.30 | 52 g | 270 | 140 kcal |
| English-muffin cheese sandwich | 20% of main plate | 83 × 2.0 = 166 ml | 0.50 | 83 g | 270 | 224 kcal |
| Sweet muffin, possibly blueberry | 20% of side plate | 57 × 4.5 ≈ 257 ml | 0.45 | 115 g | 380 | 437 kcal |
| Coffee with apparent milk | Essentially full liquid surface | 50 × 3 ≈ 150 ml | 1.0 | 150 g | 15 | 23 kcal |

### Step 8 — Sanity check
Food covers approximately **64% of the main plate** and **20% of the side plate**, consistent with the visible portions. Estimated total is **299 g of food and 150 g of drink**, providing approximately **920 kcal**. The sandwich filling, muffin density, and amount of milk are the largest uncertainties. Unopened packets are excluded.
